name: Ripple Palm
description: Strike the opponent's chest with a flat palm so a ripple of water qi runs through the ribs.

name: Still Guard
description: Spread a calm film of water qi before the body so a blow lands softened and slides off.

name: Glide Step
description: Slide one foot forward on a thin skin of water qi to close or open the distance without a sound.

name: Dew Touch
description: Lay a damp palm on an ally's shallow cut so the flesh draws water qi and begins to close.

name: Drip Jab
description: Snap two fingers into a soft point on the target with a drop of water qi riding the fingertip.

name: Soak Turn
description: Turn the forearm under an incoming fist and let the water qi soak up its force before it is shed aside.

name: Flow Palm
description: Drive an open palm from the shoulder in one smooth line so the water qi arrives at the target all at once.

name: Wash Block
description: Sweep the palm outward across an attack in a washing motion that carries the blow wide of the body.

name: Looping Turn
description: Turn in a small circle on the ball of the foot so the body swings round the line of attack.

name: Streamlet Strike
description: Let water qi run down the arm in a thin steady line and release it through the heel of the hand.

name: Rinse Hand
description: Pass a wet palm over an ally's scraped arm so flowing qi cleans the skin and knits the graze.

name: Ebb Sweep
description: Pull the arm back low and sweep it outward against the shins as water draws back from a shore.

name: Wave Push
description: Heave both palms forward so a low swell of water qi shoves the opponent off balance.

name: Ripple Tracing
description: Touch a still surface of water and read the ripple that returns to learn who walks near and how heavily.

name: Droplet Listen
description: Hold a single bead of water qi on the fingertip and feel it tremble toward the nearest moving body.

name: Damp Palm
description: Slap a wet palm onto the target's guard arm so a pulse of water qi numbs it to the elbow.

name: Seep Guard
description: Let water qi seep out across the skin and thicken into a damp cushion that absorbs a glancing blow.

name: Dart Skip
description: Skip across a wet floor on the toes with water qi under the sole to carry the body three paces.

name: Sheen Mark
description: Lay a faint film of water qi on a door or a cup so a later touch by anyone else disturbs it.

name: Current Push
description: Press both palms into the target's chest and let a slow current of water qi roll through and shove.

name: Patient Lean
description: Lean into a push and let it spend its force against a body that gives and then returns.

name: Steady Wade
description: Walk forward through a shove with the feet planted wide and water qi holding the stance low.

name: Brim Fist
description: Fill the fist with water qi to the brim and release it at the moment of contact in one heavy knock.

name: Easing Draw
description: Catch the opponent's wrist and draw it down in a smooth pull that tips the whole body forward.

name: Lap Strike
description: Slap the target's flank with the back of the hand again and again like water lapping at wood.

name: Calm Breath
description: Match an ally's breath with slow pulses of water qi until the ally's own qi settles and recovers faster.

name: Stilled Mend
description: Rest both palms on an ally's bruised ribs and let slow water qi soak the swelling down over a few breaths.

name: Moist Pulse
description: Press a damp fingertip to the target's wrist and send a quick pulse of water qi up the arm.

name: Damp Veil
description: Draw moisture from the air into a thin veil before the face and chest that weakens an incoming strike.

name: Bead Flick
description: Flick a bead of water qi from the fingertip at the target's eyes to sting and force a blink.

name: Foam Slide
description: Throw a patch of slick foam under the lead foot and slide forward along it in one long step.

name: Pulse Listen
description: Rest a wet finger on a person's wrist and read the water in the blood to learn how hurt they are.

name: Slake Touch
description: Press a cool palm to a flagging ally's back and pass in water qi that restores wind and stamina.

name: Cupped Palm
description: Slap a hollowed palm over the target's ear so a burst of water qi booms against the eardrum.

name: Ladle Throw
description: Scoop water qi in the cupped hand and fling it forward in a heavy splash that staggers the target.

name: Scoop Guard
description: Scoop an incoming strike up and aside in the hollow of the hand and let it run off the shoulder.

name: Bowl Hold
description: Hold both hands in a bowl before the chest while water qi pools between them and takes the force of a blow.

name: Dip Step
description: Dip low on one knee and rise on the other side of an attack with water qi easing the turn.

name: Sip Mend
description: Offer an ally a mouthful of water charged with qi that eases the ache of a strained muscle.

name: Tipped Cup
description: Tip the cupped hand over an ally's shoulder to pour a measure of water qi into their reserve.

name: Drip Needle
description: Narrow water qi to a needle at the fingertip and prick it through a gap in the target's guard.

name: Bead Shield
description: Hang a dozen beads of water qi before the body so each one breaks a small piece off an attack.

name: Hanging Drop
description: Let a heavy drop of qi fall from the raised hand onto a striking limb and spoil its line.

name: Plink Strike
description: Tap the same nerve point over and over with a single drop of water qi until the limb goes dead.

name: Drop Step
description: Drop the weight straight down and let the body fall one pace to the side as a drop falls from a leaf.

name: Tear Balm
description: Press one drop of water qi into an ally's open wound so it seals and stops the bleeding.

name: Well Strike
description: Draw qi up from the legs in a long pull and hurl it out through a straight punch.

name: Brimcup Guard
description: Fill the forearms with water qi to the brim so they take a hit as a full vessel takes a shake.

name: Reserve Draw
description: Haul a long breath of reserve qi from the belly into the limbs of the user or a touched ally.

name: Cool Draught
description: Give a feverish ally a cup of water qi that lowers heat and steadies a racing heart.

name: Draught Taste
description: Taste a drop of water with a touch of qi to tell whether it is clean and what it carries.

name: Rise Slide
description: Rise on a surge of water qi from the heels and carry the body a pace up and forward.

name: Well Hook
description: Hook the opponent's lead ankle with a pulling wave of water qi so the stance breaks.

name: Yield Guard
description: Give ground a half pace as the blow lands and let a layer of water qi take what remains.

name: Bend Palm
description: Bend the wrist round an attacking limb and guide it past the body along a curve of water qi.

name: Sag Step
description: Sag the whole frame under a swing and flow out the far side with the knees loose.

name: Slack Wrap
description: Wrap a loose coil of water qi around an arm and let it tighten as the opponent pulls away.

name: Cushion Wave
description: Hold a rolling cushion of water qi against an ally's back while the ally retreats under pressure.

name: Yielding Salve
description: Fold a bruised hand in both palms and let water qi draw the swelling out and the skin back to its colour.

name: Scrub Palm
description: Rub the palm hard across the target's face or arm with water qi lifting skin and breath.

name: Flush Strike
description: Drive a rushing wash of water qi through a straight arm to flush the target backward.

name: Spill Step
description: Spill the body off the line of a charge in a single loose lunge on a film of water qi.

name: Pour Hand
description: Pour water qi from the open hand over an ally's gash to wash out grit and close the edges.

name: Drain Touch
description: Touch the opponent's forearm and drain the strength out of the grip with a short draw of qi.

name: Splash Guard
description: Fling a spray of water qi at an incoming blade or fist so its line breaks and it glances off.

name: Twist Coil
description: Seize the wrist and twist the arm like cloth while water qi tightens round the joint to hold it.
